```{python}
#| label: import_libraries
# Every cell below shows a message instead of stopping the report if
# something fails; the failures are listed in the Problems tab.
import logging

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import Markdown, clear_output, display

from lecilab_behavior_analysis.figure_maker import session_summary_figure, subject_progress_figure
from lecilab_behavior_analysis.io.loading import load_project_logs, load_project_trials
from lecilab_behavior_analysis.reports import overview

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.WARNING, format="%(levelname)s %(name)s: %(message)s")
clear_output(wait=True)


def show(fig):
    """Displays a figure once (matplotlib or plotly) and closes matplotlib figures."""
    display(fig)
    plt.close("all")


# panels or cells that could not be generated, shown in the Problems tab
problems = {}
overview.reset_failed_cells()
```

```{python}
#| label: define_variables
report_date = "2026-11-02"
max_date = pd.to_datetime(report_date) + pd.Timedelta(days=1)
project = "COT_unilateral_sound_data"
subjects = ['ACV023', 'ACV024', 'ACV028', 'ACV029', 'ACV030', 'ACV031', 'ACV033']
# setups (boxes) to read events and sessions summary from; None: every setup
# found in the project folder (folders with events.csv or sessions_summary.csv)
setups = None
```

```{python}
#| label: load_data
# events and sessions summary of every setup, together (None if there are none)
events_df, sessions_summary_df, setups = load_project_logs(project, max_date, setups=setups)
# trials of every subject, prepared for the figures (subjects without data are skipped)
df = load_project_trials(project, subjects, max_date, window=50)
loaded = sorted(df["subject"].unique()) if not df.empty else []
notes = []
missing_subjects = [s for s in subjects if s not in loaded]
if missing_subjects:
    notes.append(f"No trials found for: {', '.join(missing_subjects)}")
if events_df is None or sessions_summary_df is None:
    notes.append(f"No events or sessions summary found in the setups of {project} ({', '.join(setups) or 'none'})")
display(Markdown(f"Setups: {', '.join(s or project for s in setups) or 'none found'}."))
# archive: what this report shows (empty for daily reports)
archive_note = "Archived project: data up to 2026-11-02. The tab of each subject shows its last day with data and its last 48 hours of training."
if archive_note:
    display(Markdown(f"**{archive_note}**"))
if notes:
    display(Markdown("**Note:** " + ". ".join(notes) + "."))
```

Corridor plot of the last 4 days
```{python}
#| label: make_corridor_plot
@overview.never_raises("Corridor plot", "matplotlib")
def corridor():
    from village.plots.corridor_plot import corridor_plot

    if events_df is None:
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"no events found for {project}")
    return corridor_plot(
        df=events_df,
        subjects=subjects,
        width=15,
        height=3,
        ndays=4,
        from_date=max_date + pd.Timedelta(days=0.5),
    )

show(corridor())
```

```{python}
show(overview.performance_over_trials_figure(df))
```

# ACV023

[Go back home](https://learningcircuitslab.github.io/village-report-generator/index.html)

```{python}
#| label: subject_dates_for_ACV023
mouse = "ACV023"
# day shown for this subject: the report date, or (archive) its last day with data
subject_date = "2026-10-16"
# None: the session(s) of subject_date; a number: the last hours of training (archive)
session_hours = 48
subject_df = df[df["subject"] == mouse] if not df.empty else df
if not subject_df.empty:
    subject_df = subject_df[subject_df["date"] < pd.to_datetime(subject_date) + pd.Timedelta(days=1)]
display(Markdown(f"Summary of the training history of {mouse} up to {subject_date}"))
```

```{python}
#| label: subject_summary_for_ACV023
if subject_df.empty:
    display(Markdown(f"No trials for {mouse} up to {subject_date}."))
else:
    fig = overview.never_raises(f"{mouse} training history", "matplotlib")(subject_progress_figure)(
        subject_df, perf_window=100, summary_matrix_plot=False, events_df=events_df
    )
    problems[f"{mouse} training history"] = getattr(fig, "panel_problems", [])
    show(fig)
```

```{python}
#| label: date_summary_for_ACV023
if subject_df.empty:
    sdf, period = subject_df, subject_date
elif session_hours is None:
    sdf, period = subject_df[subject_df["year_month_day"] == subject_date], subject_date
else:
    # sessions that started in the last session_hours hours of training
    sdf = subject_df[subject_df["date"] >= subject_df["date"].max() - pd.Timedelta(hours=session_hours)]
    period = f"the last {session_hours} hours of training ({sdf['date'].min():%Y-%m-%d %H:%M} to {sdf['date'].max():%Y-%m-%d %H:%M})"
if sdf.empty:
    display(Markdown(f"{mouse} did not train on {subject_date}."))
else:
    display(Markdown(f"Analysis of {period}"))
    fig = overview.never_raises(f"{mouse} session of {subject_date}", "matplotlib")(session_summary_figure)(
        sdf, perf_window=50, width=15, height=10
    )
    problems[f"{mouse} session of {subject_date}"] = getattr(fig, "panel_problems", [])
    show(fig)
```
